svg.title: Enterprise use of AI text mining in the EU-27 and Türkiye, 2024 to 2025
svg.desc: Two aligned dot plots. The first compares 2024 and 2025 percentages for enterprises with at least 10 persons employed. The second compares small, medium and large enterprises in 2025. Countries are sorted by the 2025 all-enterprise share. Exact values are in the adjacent CSV files.
svg.text: Enterprise use of AI text mining
Share using AI to analyse written language • EU-27 members and Türkiye • percent of enterprises

svg.text: Source: Eurostat isoc_eb_ai, E_AI_TTM / PC_ENT; retrieved 2026-09-09. EU aggregate shown as context; country rows sorted by 2025 all-enterprise share.
Covered activities: NACE Rev. 2 C–J, L–N and group 95.1; financial sector excluded. Values are survey estimates, not enterprise counts.
Modified analysis; Eurostat is not responsible for this presentation. Exact values, source flags and methods: observations.csv and README.md.
